title: hospital banker
summary: A hospital coordinates two nonpreemptible resource types: ventilators and pumps. Current available inventory is [1,2]. Case A holds [1,0] and may need at most [2,1] total; case B holds [1,0] and may need at most [1,2] total. A new anesthetized case C requests [1,1] now and may need at most [2,1] total. Once granted, held resources cannot be taken back until a case completes. The team must decide whether granting C's currently available request leaves a safe completion sequence.
